metadata.title: AMD sinks on revenue forecasts as competition with Nvidia grows more apparent

content.text:
Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) stock pulls back on Wednesday since the chipmaking giant topped second quarter earnings estimates alongside increased capex spending that may have shocked investors.
Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Pras Subramanian and Breaking News Reporter Jake Conley to react to AMD's projections and its growing competition with Nvidia (NVDA).
